response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg_bandusage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescope_count FROM (SELECT t."observstation", o."weathprofile", AVG(t."bandusagepct") AS group_avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM "telescopes" AS t INNER JOIN "observatories" AS o ON t."observstation" = o."observstation" WHERE t."pointaccarc" >= 4.86 GROUP BY t."observstation", o."weathprofile") AS grouped;
